name: heymey
description: HeyMey monorepo: backend, Flutter app + Desk, marketing site, infra, content and the AIDLC workspace.

scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yml --env-file infra/compose/ports.env --env-file infra/compose/images.env up -d --wait
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yml --env-file infra/compose/ports.env --env-file infra/compose/images.env down
scripts.infra:ps: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yml --env-file infra/compose/ports.env --env-file infra/compose/images.env ps
scripts.verify: pnpm ports:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm firewall:check && pnpm boundaries && turbo run lint typecheck test
